title: Feasibility and Memory Mechanisms of Chern-Simons Context Reservoir Computation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate whether a Chern-Simons (CS) context reservoir is a viable computational substrate and whether evolving its gauge connection provides a benefit beyond simpler mechanisms. The reservoir state is a density fluctuation on a two-dimensional context manifold, whose drift is generated by a density-sourced connection. To separate generic reservoir behavior from gauge-specific effects, we compare four matched models: reciprocal transport, instantaneous transverse reconstruction, local nonlinear feedback, and fully coupled conserved-current CS dynamics. Across ten random seeds, the fully coupled CS dynamics propagates Gauss law to numerical precision, converges under spatial and temporal refinement, remains stable under constraint-compatible noise, and satisfies the spatial CS equation more accurately than the instantaneous controls. All four models exhibit fading scalar memory and distinguish matched pulse-order histories in dens

translated_title: 陈-西蒙斯语境储备计算的可行性与记忆机制
translated_abstract: 我们研究了陈-西蒙斯（CS）语境储备池是否是一种可行的计算基底，以及演化其规范联络是否能提供超越更简单机制的益处。储备池状态是二维语境流形上的密度涨落，其漂移由密度源联络产生。为了将一般性的储备池行为与规范特异性效应区分开来，我们比较了四种匹配的模型：往返输运、瞬时横向重构、局部非线性反馈以及完全耦合的守恒流CS动力学。在十个随机种子上，完全耦合的CS动力学将高斯定律传播到数值精度水平，在空间和时间细化下收敛，在约束相容噪声下保持稳定，并且比瞬时对照组更精确地满足空间CS方程。所有四种模型都表现出衰减的标量记忆，并能在密集状态下区分匹配的脉冲顺序历史。
tldr: 该研究验证了陈-西蒙斯语境储备池作为计算基底的可行性，证明完全耦合的守恒流规范动力学在传播高斯定律、收敛性和抗噪稳定性方面优于更简单的机制，且所有模型均表现出衰减的标量记忆和区分脉冲顺序历史的能力。
en_tdlr: This study validates the feasibility of a Chern-Simons context reservoir as a computational substrate, demonstrating that fully coupled conserved-current gauge dynamics outperforms simpler mechanisms in propagating Gauss law, convergence, and noise stability, while all models exhibit fading scalar memory and the ability to discriminate pulse-order histories.
